notes: Contract for the MIKU_CAP lines the client prints into Game.log after login.
Every tag is one fact the payload observed inside the running game; the payload is read-only
and prints each fact on its own line, so a missing line means the probe did not reach that code
path. Checked by: python tools/devlog.py cap --expect
Types: int | id_list (a,b,c) | map (k=v,...) | flag (fixed value) | bool | text.
required=false means the fact may legitimately be absent (module not loaded yet).
forbidden=true means the tag must NOT appear; 'error' is printed only when the payload's pcall

gacha_ids.why: Gacha.tbGacha keys: an empty table means the gacha config never loaded

display.why: Gacha.tbDisplayGroup -> nGachaId; a display row pointing at a missing pool is a blank banner

curdlc.why: DLC_Logic.GetCurConf().nId: the era the client actually opened with

online16_level.why: Online.GetConfig(16).ResetLevel; nil means the online config row is absent

pool_in_time.why: pools the client currently treats as inside their window; empty is a legitimate answer

pool_floor.why: MikuPoolFloor written by the GachaPoolWindows payload; nil before that payload runs

done.why: end-of-block sentinel; its absence means the payload died before finishing

error.why: printed instead of 'done' when the payload's pcall failed
